win_system.notes:
WAYS TO WIN

 The specified requirements for a winning combination in the base game are also used during bonus features or free spins play unless otherwise stated. Each wager is eligible for all winning combinations unless otherwise stated.

 You win if matching symbols appear on adjacent reels from left to right, starting with the leftmost reel. Each winning combination of matching symbols creates a winning way. The number of possible ways in this game is 4096. Please consult the paytable for t

wilds.name: WILD ROWS
wilds.behavior: Wild Laser Cat Symbols can land on reels 2-6. When it lands, the Wild Laser Cat Symbol will shoot a laser beam to the left across all positions on the same row. All positions that are covered by a Wild Laser Cat Symbol or the laser beam become Wild symbols that substitute for all symbols in the paytable.

specials.name: VOLATILITY SWITCH
specials.behavior: The volatility switch is displayed outside the grid. Flip the switch to toggle between the extreme and normal volatility modes. Normal Volatility means that you usually win smaller but more often, Extreme Volatility means that you usually win bigger but less frequently
